exhibits.title: The five questions an investor asks, answered
exhibits.subtitle: Answer, deciding evidence and how sure we are · desk research to early Oct 2026
rows: How big is demand, and how fast could it grow?
About 4.5 MW of IT load in use in 2026; 6.5-40 MW by 2030, base case 12 MW
Vietnam ~100 MW operational [VNS 2026]; Cambodia ~7 MW [KF Dec 2024]; scenarios [Kira estimates]
How does the value chain work, and where is the margin?
The state holds power and grid; margin goes to whoever secures cheap power and an anchor tenant
Grid 90% held by China Southern Power Grid [AidData]; landlord 86.8% vs operator 49% margins [Keppel DC FY2025] [Equinix FY2025]
What does capacity cost, and what returns can it earn?
US$7-10 m per MW to build; payback ~19 years alone, 6.5-8.5 anchored
Vietnam US$5.5-8.5 m per MW [C&W 2025]; 2 MW hall model [Kira estimates]
Who is already investing, and is there room?
Four small live operators and three studies; room for one neutral, bank-grade operator
National cloud partnership [GDMS 2024]; 15 GW MoU [Detik Feb 2026]
What are the key risks, and which route fits?
Grid reliability, tariff path and kip convertibility; enter as a partner, not greenfield
Outages [VT Aug 2025]; Fitch CCC+ [Fitch Oct 2025]; route scoring [Kira estimates]
